issue: #576 — Flat reversion P5, family rebind lane B, reference-input-no-idx (Q31), on spec #565
spec: docs/spec/midgard-tx.md §5.3, §7.1, §8.8, §10.5 — field 1 reference inputs read through the §8.8 door by arithmetic at field 0's shared 38-byte stride, under authenticate-once
note: Lane B's rolling re-measurement, attached as this lane's exit criterion per #565's measurement-slotting rule (AC3). The Q31 rebind swaps the counted `field_commitment_from_items` re-hash of a prover-reproduced item list for a single authenticate-once hash plus an O(1) arithmetic read (field 1, step-02) and an authenticated item-count read (field 2, step-04). It introduces NO new unbounded walk: step-02 is fixed-stride arithmetic and step-04 reads the §5.1 authenticated count, so there is no `basisFit:"exceeds"` row and no infeasibility string. Q31's cardinality-growth bound is the parent-owned Q1x envelope (`native-tx-q1x-exec-ledger-v1.json`): field 1 shares field 0's 38-byte stride, so that ledger's field-0/1 stride rows and step-04 outputs-count rows apply unchanged. Regenerate with `MIDGARD_AIKEN_BIN=<fork> node scripts/verify-q31-exec-ledger-v1.mjs --update`, and move any reported number in the same commit. Provisional: formal closure is Phase 7's, against the Phase-6 blueprint. `--update` rewrites the raw mem/cpu rows; it does NOT rewrite `basisFit`, and it is not a bypass — structural failures (a row or selector that did not run, or a fresh reading that contradicts a `within` judgement by exceeding the basis) fail in update mode too and the ledger is not rewritten.
